description: This Java source file contains unit tests for scheduler job functionalities within the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup and teardown procedures, tests for date formatting, toggling scheduler status, verifying the number of scheduled jobs, flipping individual job active statuses, and manually triggering all scheduler jobs.

classes.name: SchedulerJobsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing scheduler job operations in Apache Fineract, including enabling/disabling scheduler, verifying job status, and manual job execution.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST assured, sets up request specifications with authorization headers, and captures the original scheduler and job statuses before tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Restores the original scheduler and job statuses after each test execution.

methods.name: testDateFormat
methods.description: Tests that the 'nextRunTime' of the earliest scheduled job can be parsed using ISO_INSTANT format, ensuring correct date formatting and parsing.

methods.name: testFlippingSchedulerStatus
methods.description: Verifies that toggling the scheduler's active status properly updates and reflects the state.

methods.name: testNumberOfJobs
methods.description: Checks that the number of scheduled jobs matches the expected count from enum 'JobName'.

methods.name: testFlippingJobsActiveStatus
methods.description: Tests flipping the active status of each scheduled job individually while the scheduler is disabled.

methods.name: testTriggeringManualExecutionOfAllSchedulerJobs
methods.description: Temporarily enables a configuration, then manually triggers all scheduled jobs and subsequently disables the configuration.
